name: @yourorg/testpilot-mcp

scripts.inspect:legacy: MCP_INSPECTOR_SECRET_STORE=memory npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.10.1 --cli node dist/index.js --protocol-era legacy --method tools/list --strict
scripts.inspect:modern: MCP_INSPECTOR_SECRET_STORE=memory npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.10.1 --cli node dist/index.js --protocol-era modern --method tools/list --strict
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && git add package.json package-lock.json plugins README.md docs/install.md
